scope: Repository language metadata for round-three additions, using official GitHub Languages API breakdowns where available and project-owned language evidence otherwise.

records.evidence: GitHub's official repository Languages endpoint reports Java as the largest tracked language total (43,164,284 bytes).

GitHub's official Languages endpoint for the canonical core repository reports Zig (44,701 bytes). The separately maintained Android front-end repository reports Kotlin (5,747 bytes) at https://api.github.com/repos/zproot/zproot-android/languages; the project row label reflects the canonical core repository.
GitHub's official repository Languages endpoint reports Rust as the largest tracked language total (16,694,694 bytes).

GitHub's official Languages REST endpoint reports 5,387,495 bytes of C++ as the largest total (72.3% of 7,446,628 recognized language bytes) for the repository. The full repository byte breakdown is recorded in language_breakdown_bytes.

GitHub's official Languages REST endpoint reports 2,289,216 bytes of C++ as the largest total (94.6% of 2,420,869 recognized language bytes) for the repository. The full repository byte breakdown is recorded in language_breakdown_bytes.

GitHub's official Languages REST endpoint reports 61,297 bytes of Objective-C++ as the largest total (43.3% of 141,540 recognized language bytes) for the repository. The full repository byte breakdown is recorded in language_breakdown_bytes.

GitHub's official Languages REST endpoint reports 685,109 bytes of C++ as the largest total (65.4% of 1,047,475 recognized language bytes) for the repository. The full repository byte breakdown is recorded in language_breakdown_bytes.

GitHub's official Languages API returned 8,730,282 C bytes out of 14,223,806 classified bytes (61.38%), the largest category, followed by Python (2,482,307 bytes; 17.45%) and Swift (1,972,999 bytes; 13.87%). This is a repository-wide measure that includes component sources and build tooling; it does not mean the iOS front end itself is primarily C.

GitHub's official Languages API returned 4,042,451 C bytes out of 4,786,522 classified bytes (84.45%), the largest category, followed by Python (716,502 bytes; 14.97%). This is a repository-wide breakdown and includes project tooling as well as matching game source.
